dispatches.bufferization: static global destinations; thread-local scalar fusion buffers; no device malloc
dispatches.schedule: parallel output coordinates per thread; serial reduction loops
dispatches.triton_exclusion: softmax: requires equal positive static rank-one unencoded FP32 input and output tensors; reduction: requires a canonical Linalg sum-reduction root; dot: requires a canonical Linalg MatMul root; pointwise: requires a single-result tensor Linalg operation

kernel_backends: native-vortex + triton-vortex; single linked device module
schedule: serialized dispatches; SSA last-use buffer reuse
template: per-dispatch native kernels or flat masked Triton tiles
